name: unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> Box < T , A >
rule: The caller must guarantee that the value contained in `self` is fully initialized as a valid `T` before calling `assume_init`; calling it on content that is not fully initialized causes immediate undefined behavior.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::boxed::Box < mem::MaybeUninit < T > , A > { unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> alloc::boxed::Box < T , A > }
